subject: general
question: Which if the following is a landmark judgement of Justice Bela Trivedi, whose official retirement is scheduled for June 2025?

options.text: Challenge to the Abrogaon of Arcle 370
Euthanasia and the Right to Die with Dignity

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruling on POCSO Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Justice Bela Trivedi delivered a landmark judgment related to the **POCSO Act (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act)**, emphasizing the protection of minors from sexual offenses.
 
• The judgment focused on interpreting provisions of the act to ensure robust safeguarding mechanisms for children against exploitation and abuse.
 
• The court highlighted the importance of ensuring child-friendly procedures during investigation and trial, aligning with the objectives of the **POCSO Act**. *Hence, the correct option is "Ruling on POCSO Act."*
 
• Justice Bela Trivedi
